Enjoy Negila Hididhu, A Classic Lyrical Song From The Kannada Movie Kaamana Billu, Featuring Dr. Rajkumar And Anant Nag, With Music By Upendra Kumar.
Relive The Golden Era Of Kannada Cinema With This Memorable Melody, Presented By MRT Music. Enjoy The Lyrics And Celebrate The Rich Musical Heritage Of Kannada Old Songs.
Kannada Old Songs, Lyrical Videos, Evergreen Melodies, And Classic Hits.
Directed by: Chi. Dattaraj
Produced by: J. Jayamma
Written by: Ashwini
Artist Name: Rajkumar, Anant Nag, Saritha
Music Director: Upendra Kumar
